title: Blue Wave Billboard Triptych in Metal Corridor
whatItIs: Three vertical screens on a brushed steel wall: pale blue paper-wave 3D art with 'Your money Your control', a blue silhouette profile with 'Move money. No friction.', and a deep blue orb with glass blocks and 'Spend smarter Live easier'.
whatItMeans: Three visual worlds in one blue palette show range while staying recognisably one brand.
techniques: Three different image styles in one colour family
Short two-line headlines in navy or white
Pill logo lockup in each corner
Metallic wall to contrast the soft blue
Small legal and tagline text at the edges
bestFor: Poster series with a shared palette

A 3D render of folded, flowing paper-like sheets.
A poster built around a dark outline of a person.
